periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation tilted approximately 45 degrees downward toward the snout.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant tapering at the lower edge, creating a teardrop-like extension below the geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between pinnae, approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded semicircular profile at the superior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible yellow-ochre staining on the posterior dorsal white pelage.
